messages:
deepa: Quick note — I flipped the endpoint-aliasing flag for a demo and the console p99 for /embed suddenly jumped ~120ms. Not seeing the same jump in raw traces. Anyone seen percentile 'aliasing' before?

mike: Hmm. Alias = merging multiple endpoint keys under one rollup, right? Could be mixing samples with different token lengths.

oliver: Can you paste the aggregate numbers? p50/p95/p99 + sample counts for the rollup vs individual endpoints?

deepa: sure, grabbed from the UI:
```
rollup: p50 18ms p95 72ms p99 420ms samples 420
svc-a: p50 16ms p95 68ms p99 72ms samples 200
svc-b: p50 22ms p95 80ms p99 385ms samples 200
```

sara: That looks like one endpoint has a fat tail and the rollup's p99 shifts toward the heavier tails when merged. But a 420ms p99 for the rollup while both endpoints show lower-ish p99s is weird. Are we doing t-digest merges incorrectly?

tim: We merge t-digests at ingestion by endpoint tag. Alias rewrites the tag, so we merge digests from two different distributions into one digest. That's expected to change percentiles — but not usually that large. Could be sampling differences (we sample fewer heavy-tail requests) or our digest compression setting.

mike: Right — two possibilities: 1) sampling bias (heavy requests overrepresented in svc-b), 2) t-digest bucket compression causing interpolation artifact.

oliver: Quick check: can we pull raw sample timestamps+latency for a 5m window for both endpoints (pre-alias and post-alias) and compute exact empirical percentiles? I can run a local script.

deepa: I ran a quick grep on traces and saw more long-running requests from svc-b but the trace counts are lower than the metrics sample count. Might be double-counting retries in metrics.

sara: If retries are included in metrics but excluded in traces, that would explain discrepancy. Which pipeline tag marks retries?

mike: retry_tag = transport.attempt>1 in collector. We currently do not normalize retry status before rollup aliasing. So a rollup that groups retries with first attempts could skew p99.

tim: Proposed mitigations: a) mark and drop retries from percentile aggregation b) keep percentile derivation on the original endpoint tag and only alias for counts/cost c) show sample-origin breakdown in the UI so people can see mix.

deepa: I like (c) as a quick UX bandage. For short term we should opt for (b) for p99 SLOs (derive p99 from raw endpoint tag).

oliver: I'll run the empirical percentile script now and post numbers. If it matches traces, we commit to (b).

deploy-bot: new branch created: fix/percentile-source-preserve-raw-namespace (PR #4128)

deepa: thanks — assigning follow-up: oliver to validate, tim to prototype switch for p99 derivation, sara to add UI sample-origin badge mock. We'll sync tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
